description: This source file defines an abstract class 'CommonLoanSummaryDataProvider' that implements the 'LoanSummaryDataProvider' interface. It provides methods to calculate and assemble loan summary data, including transaction amount summaries, based on loan transaction balances and repayment schedules. The class contains logic to fetch specific transaction type balances, handle reversed transactions, and compute unpaid interest amounts, serving as a core component for generating detailed loan summaries in the system.

classes.name: CommonLoanSummaryDataProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing implementation for generating loan summary data such as transaction amounts, outstanding interests, and other financial metrics, based on provided loan data, transaction balances, and repayment schedules.

methods.name: withTransactionAmountsSummary
methods.description: Generates a detailed loan summary data object with transaction amounts, including various refunds, adjustments, and interests, based on the loan, existing summary data, repayment schedule, and transaction balances.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionBalanceByType
methods.description: Fetches the total amount of a specific transaction type from the collection of loan transaction balances, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionBalanceReversedByType
methods.description: Fetches the total amount of a specific transaction type that has been reversed or manually adjusted from the collection of loan transaction balances.

methods.name: computeTotalUnpaidPayableDueInterestAmount
methods.description: Calculates total unpaid interest due on periods that are past due, up to the current business date.

methods.name: withOnlyCurrencyData
methods.description: Creates a LoanSummaryData object containing only the currency information.
